import os
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', NS)

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
DST = 'sales_data.new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')

# ---- sheet1.xml: add Profit Margin % column (H) ----
root = ET.fromstring(zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

dim = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}dimension')
dim.set('ref', 'A1:H10')

cols = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cols')
col = ET.SubElement(cols, f'{{{NS}}}col')
col.set('min', '8'); col.set('max', '8'); col.set('width', '14'); col.set('customWidth', '1')

sheetData = root.find(f'{{{NS}}}sheetData')
for row in sheetData.findall(f'{{{NS}}}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    c = ET.SubElement(row, f'{{{NS}}}c')
    c.set('r', f'H{r}')
    if r == 1:
        c.set('s', '1')
        c.set('t', 'inlineStr')
        is_el = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}is')
        t = ET.SubElement(is_el, f'{{{NS}}}t')
        t.text = 'Profit Margin %'
    else:
        c.set('s', '4' if r == 10 else '3')
        f = ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}f')
        f.text = f'G{r}/E{r}'
        ET.SubElement(c, f'{{{NS}}}v')

# ---- styles.xml: add 0.0% number format and two cellXfs ----
styles_root = ET.fromstring(zin.read('xl/styles.xml'))

numFmts = styles_root.find(f'{{{NS}}}numFmts')
numFmts.set('count', '1')
nf = ET.SubElement(numFmts, f'{{{NS}}}numFmt')
nf.set('numFmtId', '164'); nf.set('formatCode', '0.0%')

cellXfs = styles_root.find(f'{{{NS}}}cellXfs')
cellXfs.set('count', '5')
for font_id in ('0', '1'):
    xf = ET.SubElement(cellXfs, f'{{{NS}}}xf')
    xf.set('numFmtId', '164'); xf.set('fontId', font_id)
    xf.set('fillId', '0'); xf.set('borderId', '0')
    xf.set('applyNumberFormat', '1'); xf.set('xfId', '0')

# ---- write new zip ----
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(DST, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        data = ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
    elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
        data = ET.tostring(styles_root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
    else:
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()

os.replace(DST, SRC)
print('done')
